blocks.task_summary: Show that the acute angle between planes P1 and P2 is 60°.
method_path: Identify normal vectors n1 = (1,2,1) and n2 = (1,-1,-2)

evidence.basis: normals of Π1 and Π2 are (1,2,1) and (1,-1,-2) (A1); attempt to use the scalar product for the angle between two vectors M1; -3 = 6 cos θ A1A1; cos θ = -1/2 A1; θ = 120° OR cos(180-θ) = 1/2 A1; acute angle is 60° AG

blocks.task_summary: Find the Cartesian equation of plane P3, which is perpendicular to both P1 and P2 and passes through R(5,-5,5).
method_path: Compute cross product of normals n1 × n2 = (-3,3,-3) or (1,-1,1)
Form plane equation: -3x + 3y - 3z = d or x - y + z = d
Substitute R(5,-5,5) to find d = -45 or d = 15
Write Cartesian equation: -3x + 3y - 3z = -45 or x - y + z = 15
accepted_alternatives: Use cross product to get normal (1,-1,1) and equation x - y + z = 15

evidence.basis: attempt to find vector product of their normal vectors M1; cross product result (A1); equation of Π3 is -3x+3y-3z=d or x-y+z=d or equivalent; attempt to substitute (5,-5,5) into their equation (M1); equation of Π3 is -3x+3y-3z=-45 (so x-y+z=15) A1
